spec.description: Cost of the ORCHESTRATOR: the main pi session that runs /flow, counting only its own LLM calls (never the subagent sessions it spawns). Subagents have their own dashboard.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

spec.description: Main-session cost of tickets pushed within the selected time range (own LLM calls only, no subagents).
spec.title: Orchestrator spend

spec.description: One bar per day = exact change in recorded cost levels during that day (all agents). Day-by-day is the honest granularity here: weekly bars from PromQL anchor to epoch-aligned Thursdays and go dark around the pushgateway restart; read weeks as 7 bars, or use the 7d total below. Days missing around the restart (~Nov 12) show as gaps and self-heal over time.
spec.title: Spend per day (last month)

spec.description: All-time = every session still recorded by pushgateway (the de-facto year total until pi-flow crosses a year boundary). 7d/30d = exact spend accrued in the trailing window. All agents, mode/ref filters apply.
spec.title: Spend totals — all-time, last 7d, last 30d (all agents)

spec.expr: count(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

spec.description: Tickets with orchestrator cost pushed within the selected time range. Older tickets (before main-session tracking) have none.
spec.title: Tickets

spec.expr: avg(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))
quantile(0.5, sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

sum(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} > (time() - 86400) and push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} <= time())) or vector(0)

spec.description: At each point: orchestrator cost of tickets pushed in the preceding 24 hours (push time = when the run ended).
spec.title: Orchestrator spend in the last 24h (rolling)

spec.description: Where the orchestrator's own money went, stacked by phase (plan | implement | validate). Hover a segment for that phase's cost.
spec.title: Orchestrator cost per ticket, stacked by phase

spec.expr: sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref", agent="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow", mode=~"${mode:raw}"} >= (time() - $__range_s))

label_replace(label_replace(label_join( ( sum by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) ) * on (ref) group_left (title) topk by (ref) (1, pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}), "ticket", " — ", "ref", "title"), "url", "https://salaryhero.atlassian.net/browse/$1", "ref", "(.*)"), "url", "", "mode", "^$|personal") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace( ( sum by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) ) unless on (ref) pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}, "ticket", "$1", "ref", "(.+)"), "url", "https://salaryhero.atlassian.net/browse/$1", "ref", "(.*)"), "url", "", "mode", "^$|personal")

spec.description: Orchestrator = the main session's own cost only (agent="main"); the Plan / Implement / Validate columns split it by phase. Subagents = every worker / reviewer / scout session of the ticket (agent!="main"). Ticket total = orchestrator + subagents. "–" = not recorded (orchestrator cost exists only for runs after main-session tracking). Duration = summed phase wall-clock, including time spent waiting on a human.
spec.title: Tickets: orchestrator cost and where it went

spec.description: Token kinds: input | output | cache read | cache write. Ratio = cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite) for the main agent (agent="main") per ticket. Low = prompts not cached = expensive. Was a barchart; 60 refs made it an unreadable wall.
spec.title: Orchestrator cache hit ratio per ticket (higher = cheaper)

spec.description: Rising line = spend accrued so far in the rolling 7-day window (all agents), updated live. Each point is the exact cost-level change since the previous point (increase() undercounts these push-style gauges). Note: the Nov 12 pushgateway restart re-pushed old tickets and the line double-counts that bump (~$4) until it rolls out of the window ~Nov 21.
spec.title: Cumulative spend, day by day (last 7 days)
